featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

With support for 4K/HDR resolutions, HDCP 2.2, and HD multi-channel audio formats, this four-output splitter allows for simple, reliable distribution of a single HDMI source to multiple duplicate displays. Additionally, the compact chassis makes it perfect for environments where unobtrusive installation is important.

With support for 4K/60 4:4:4 and a powerful backplane capable of "fully-loaded" 18Gbps distribution to four outputs, the SP-0104-H2 is the perfect way to achieve multi-point, single source distribution.

The latest 4K UHD content arriving via satellite, cable, disc or stream is all heavily encrypted to protect it from being illegally duplicated. Being part of the H2 product family, the SP-0104-H2 supports the multi-point distribution of this content over HDBaseT.

With multiple EDID tables to choose from, the SP-0104-H2 comes with various EDID options to optimise sink-source communication. Built-in EDID's allow a defined timing signal to be selected or copy mode from port #1 means that a connected screen can be used as the master.
Coming complete with mounting brackets, the SP-0104-H2 can be both wall & surface mounted. The 18mm chassis allows for unobtrusive installation.
Supports resolutions up to 4K@60Hz, including 3840x2160 (HDR) and 4096x2160 (DCI) and 1920x1080p@60Hz
Multichannel Dolby and DTS HD audio supported up to 7.1 (mirrors source)
12v DC 1A power supply and mounting brackets included
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx
